name: Science Quest — Interactive Extras
description: Three-blank carbon cycle, density MCQ with diagram, virtual density lab.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.
questions.text:
Plants take in ___ dioxide from the air.
Animals return carbon dioxide to the air through ___.
Dead organisms are broken down by ___.
questions.explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide for photosynthesis; animals release CO₂ by respiration; decomposers (bacteria and fungi) break down dead organisms.

questions.prompt: A rock has a mass of 120 g and a volume of 40 cm³. What is its density?
questions.explanation: Density = mass ÷ volume = 120 g ÷ 40 cm³ = 3.0 g/cm³.

questions.prompt: Virtual Density Challenge: weigh the stone, lower it into the measuring cylinder, then calculate its density.
questions.explanation: Mass = 81 g. Volume = 62 − 35 = 27 cm³. Density = 81 ÷ 27 = 3.0 g/cm³.
